00be0b76bf74.en: “Hrrrrgggghh,” Gabiro replied with a pained grunt. He opened his eyes, looking at a worm about the size of his thumb rapidly burrowing itself on his hand. “Fuck!” Flinching, Gabiro pulled on the worm with all the waning strength that he had, tearing it in half, spilling its worm guts and blood everywhere, and throwing it into the ooze puddle.
00be0b76bf74.t: “Hrrrrgggghh,” jawab Gabiro dengan erangan kesakitan. Ia membuka matanya, memandang seekor cacing kira-kira seukuran jempolnya dengan cepat menggali masuk ke tangannya. “Bangsat!” Tersentak, Gabiro menarik cacing itu dengan sisa tenaga yang memudar yang ia punya, merobeknya menjadi dua, menumpahkan isi perut dan darah cacing ke mana-mana, dan melemparkannya ke genangan lendir itu.

057ac048fb5a.en: Gabiro Sanbi Royal, a one-of-a-kind scientist, agitatedly raised his voice at his apprentice, Kibe. “Why the fuck did you bring me a dead bagarisa?” Gabiro’s old frail body and whitened eyes contrasted with his youthful, emotionally charged response; his nose twitched, sensing the pungent, musky odor of wet dog mixed with woody notes, with aftertaste of rotten smell coming from the dead bagarisa—a pig-like animal with tusks pointing downwards, famous for its pungent scent glands found at the base of its red mane, making it absolutely gleam in the sunlight. It’s beautiful to look at from afar, but you might gag up close.
057ac048fb5a.t: Gabiro Sanbi Royal, ilmuwan yang tiada duanya, dengan gusar meninggikan suaranya kepada muridnya, Kibe. “Kenapa kau membawakanku bagarisa mati, bangsat?” Tubuh Gabiro yang tua dan rapuh serta matanya yang memutih bertolak belakang dengan responsnya yang muda dan penuh emosi; hidungnya berkedut, mencium bau musk menyengat seperti anjing basah bercampur nuansa kayu, dengan sisa bau busuk yang datang dari bagarisa mati itu—hewan mirip babi dengan taring yang mengarah ke bawah, terkenal karena kelenjar baunya yang menyengat yang terdapat di pangkal surai merahnya, membuatnya benar-benar berkilau di bawah sinar matahari. Indah dipandang dari jauh, tetapi kamu mungkin mual dari dekat.

0f191cb97b5c.en: That’s definitely for Maiara—no way the other princess would ask for something like that. Kibe pondered more, looking at the dripping blood from Gabiro’s hands. Strange we would be doing something this experimental though. I mean, it’s just a fake body, so why are we going through the trouble? Kibe drew breath to speak, but then stopped himself short. Aww whatever. If Gabiro defunds the department’s monthly budget, then I will just take it up with Neferteri.
0f191cb97b5c.t: Itu jelas untuk Maiara—tidak mungkin putri yang lain meminta yang seperti itu. Kibe merenung lebih jauh, memandangi darah yang menetes dari tangan Gabiro. Aneh juga kita melakukan sesuatu yang seeksperimental ini. Maksudku, ini kan cuma fake body, jadi kenapa kita repot-repot begini? Kibe menarik napas untuk berbicara, tetapi lalu menahan dirinya. Ah, terserahlah. Kalau Gabiro menghabiskan anggaran bulanan departemen, aku akan mengadukannya saja ke Neferteri.

193d302d5f07.en: This is ancient stuff! Is this still for Maiara? Kibe, meanwhile, stayed silently watching whatever Gabiro was attempting to do. His eyes shifted to the box filled with nari stones—a stone encapsulated by a green wood frame that allowed multiple stones to be chained together, forming a stick. Each stone had a blue hue inside that felt like a trapped gas of sorts, appearing as if the blue would swirl around if you shook it with your hand. Glancing at the size of each stick, and the sheer amount of them, Kibe gasped, “There’s like ten per stick? Did you use our entire budget for this?” Kibe’s eyes grew serious for once, “Am I gonna get my salary tomorrow?”
193d302d5f07.t: Ini cara kuno sekali! Apa ini masih untuk Maiara? Kibe, sementara itu, diam saja menonton apa pun yang sedang dicoba Gabiro. Matanya beralih ke kotak yang penuh batu nari—batu yang terbungkus bingkai kayu hijau yang memungkinkan banyak batu dirangkai bersama, membentuk sebatang tongkat. Setiap batu memiliki rona biru di dalamnya yang terasa seperti semacam gas yang terperangkap, tampak seolah warna biru itu akan berputar-putar kalau kamu mengguncangnya dengan tangan. Melirik ukuran setiap batang, dan banyaknya batang itu, Kibe tersentak, “Ada sekitar sepuluh per batang? Apa kau memakai seluruh anggaran kita untuk ini?” Mata Kibe menjadi serius untuk sekali ini, “Apa aku akan dapat gajiku besok?”

1e2367279685.en: Kibe, turning himself away from viewing such a decrepit body, glanced around the room. A closed door, a few bookshelves, and wooden drawers encircled them, but that was it. He suddenly realized there was something crucial missing as his eyes widened. “Wait! Where’s the guy? The body!”
1e2367279685.t: Kibe, membalikkan badan agar tidak melihat tubuh yang begitu renta, melirik ke sekeliling ruangan. Sebuah pintu yang tertutup, beberapa rak buku, dan laci-laci kayu mengelilingi mereka, tetapi hanya itu. Tiba-tiba ia menyadari ada sesuatu yang penting yang kurang saat matanya membelalak. “Tunggu! Di mana orangnya? Tubuhnya!”

26be9d7809ec.en: With his heart pounding, Kibe still could not move. He watched Gabiro scream in pain, his body slowly melting away into a white fiery ooze. Kibe could not fathom a thought, watching with pure fearful awe the growing brightness of the two ooze clusters, roaring in flames as they drew closer to one another, nearly touching.
26be9d7809ec.t: Dengan jantung berdebar, Kibe masih tidak bisa bergerak. Ia melihat Gabiro menjerit kesakitan, tubuhnya perlahan meleleh menjadi lendir putih yang menyala. Kibe tidak bisa memikirkan apa pun, menonton dengan rasa takjub yang murni penuh ketakutan dua gumpalan lendir yang semakin terang, menderu dalam api saat keduanya semakin mendekat satu sama lain, hampir bersentuhan.

281871aa082f.en: Tightly clenching his teeth, Gabiro made a nerve pop up in his forehead. He seemed to hold back for what seemed an instant, but soon after he extended his hand towards the dead bagarisa, and exploded verbally. “Were you smoking Sanbi shit? How is a fucking bagarisa the most powerful thing?” A fly, perusing the corpse, decided to switch targets, and headed straight into Gabiro’s open mouth. Coughing, he spit the fly out. “Dammit, Kibe! Why the fuck didn’t you use ice create?”
281871aa082f.t: Menggertakkan giginya erat-erat, Gabiro membuat urat menonjol di dahinya. Ia tampak menahan diri untuk sesaat, tetapi tak lama kemudian ia mengulurkan tangannya ke arah bagarisa mati itu, dan meledak secara verbal. “Kau habis mengisap tahi Sanbi? Bagaimana bisa bagarisa sialan jadi makhluk paling kuat?” Seekor lalat, yang sedang menjelajahi bangkai itu, memutuskan untuk berganti sasaran, dan langsung menuju mulut Gabiro yang terbuka. Terbatuk-batuk, ia meludahkan lalat itu. “Sialan, Kibe! Kenapa kau tidak memakai ice create, bangsat?”

2a6bf50fe605.en: Prologue subchapter 2: the old scientist works glowing light around his arm over the carcass while the silver-haired man watches, arms crossed.
2a6bf50fe605.t: Prolog subbab 2: ilmuwan tua itu menggerakkan cahaya berpendar di sekitar lengannya di atas bangkai, sementara pria berambut perak mengamati sambil bersedekap.

2d846ad080b0.en: 1039 A.G Paulin 14th, Gannday at about Sunnilow. Another beautiful average summer morning, with a humid wind carrying hints of salty, fishy air, contrasting with a warming sun tickling the skin. Birds doing birdy things, fish doing fishy things, and humans … doing fishy things too. Amongst all the commonality of what would be just another day, two people stood by themselves on the fourth floor of Sanbi Kingdom’s Castle Southwest tower, with one of them clearly not looking pleased.
2d846ad080b0.t: Gannday, 14 Paulin 1039 A.G, sekitar Sunnilow. Satu lagi pagi musim panas biasa yang indah, dengan angin lembap yang membawa nuansa udara asin dan amis, kontras dengan matahari hangat yang menggelitik kulit. Burung-burung melakukan urusan burung, ikan-ikan melakukan urusan ikan, dan manusia … juga melakukan urusan amis. Di antara semua kelaziman dari apa yang seharusnya hanya hari biasa, dua orang berdiri sendirian di lantai empat Southwest tower Kastil Kerajaan Sanbi, dengan salah satunya jelas tidak tampak senang.

2e052e4d5e46.en: “You’re out.” Kibe, grabbing one of the nari sticks, placed the pointy edge of the blue nari stones towards the bloodied palm.
2e052e4d5e46.t: “Kau sudah habis.” Kibe, mengambil salah satu batang nari, meletakkan ujung runcing batu nari biru itu ke arah telapak tangan yang berdarah.

307dbb61daf0.en: “Well, they called it the amethyst smelly killer.” Kibe let go of Gabiro’s stick as he felt the jabs stop. His eyes finally had enough courage to glance back at Gabiro, rubbing his hand on his chin.
307dbb61daf0.t: “Yah, mereka menyebutnya pembunuh bau amethyst.” Kibe melepaskan tongkat Gabiro saat ia merasakan tusukan-tusukan itu berhenti. Matanya akhirnya punya cukup keberanian untuk kembali melirik Gabiro, sambil menggosok dagunya dengan tangan.

3105fd0c06bf.en: Kibe avoided eye contact with Gabiro’s exposed skin, but his eyes were just curious enough to bring them back. “White balls?” Kibe paid close attention to how ghastly white the balls were. “What are we doing messing with the soul? That’s dangerous!”
3105fd0c06bf.t: Kibe menghindari memandang kulit Gabiro yang terbuka, tetapi matanya cukup penasaran untuk kembali memandang. “Bola putih?” Kibe memperhatikan baik-baik betapa pucatnya bola-bola itu. “Kenapa kita mengutak-atik jiwa? Itu berbahaya!”

386ad124a87e.en: “Enough time? You had two fucking days! That’s why we are meeting here instead, you asshole!” Gabiro immediately shot down the argument, shooing away the other curious flies from his mouth—perhaps Gabiro’s old age was just as fragrant as the dead bagarisa’s.
386ad124a87e.t: “Cukup waktu? Kau punya dua hari, bangsat! Itulah sebabnya kita bertemu di sini, dasar bajingan!” Gabiro langsung mematahkan argumen itu, mengusir lalat-lalat penasaran lainnya dari mulutnya—mungkin usia tua Gabiro sama harumnya dengan bagarisa mati itu.

3c98de644f24.en: A numbing feeling appeared next, followed by intense comforting warmth, like entering a hot tub in the middle of the winter. Kibe’s vision, fussy and tunneling, spotted a torn up room, with a weakening white fire on top of the table, slowly revealing a corpulent human body. He tried to move his neck, but it didn’t budge. He tried to move his fingers, but they refused to acknowledge its owner. A breath, maybe he could breathe—nope. He was stuck, paralyzed inside his own dying body.
3c98de644f24.t: Perasaan mati rasa muncul berikutnya, disusul kehangatan menenangkan yang hebat, seperti masuk ke bak air panas di tengah musim dingin. Penglihatan Kibe, yang buram dan menyempit, melihat ruangan yang porak-poranda, dengan api putih yang melemah di atas meja, perlahan memperlihatkan tubuh manusia yang gemuk. Ia mencoba menggerakkan lehernya, tetapi lehernya tidak bergeming. Ia mencoba menggerakkan jari-jarinya, tetapi jari-jari itu menolak mengakui pemiliknya. Satu napas, mungkin ia bisa bernapas—tidak. Ia terjebak, lumpuh di dalam tubuhnya sendiri yang sekarat.

3ca03cb46c95.en: 1039 A.G Paulin 14th, Gannday at about Sunnilow. Another beautiful average summer morning, with a humid wind carrying hints of salty, fishy air, contrasting…
3ca03cb46c95.t: Gannday, 14 Paulin 1039 A.G, sekitar Sunnilow. Satu lagi pagi musim panas biasa yang indah, dengan angin lembap yang membawa nuansa udara asin dan amis, kontras dengan…

410be2d5fcd8.en: “Pfff. Three aquamarines are more than fucking enough. I could have negotiated for a Darfaries corpse with that kind of money. You’re not even trying! You dipshit!” A boastful speech came from Gabiro, but then his eyes narrowed as he grew suspicious. “How much did this shit cost?”
410be2d5fcd8.t: “Pfff. Tiga aquamarine itu sudah lebih dari cukup, bangsat. Aku bisa saja menawar mayat Darfaries dengan uang sebanyak itu. Kau bahkan tidak berusaha! Dasar tolol!” Pidato sombong keluar dari Gabiro, tetapi kemudian matanya menyipit karena ia mulai curiga. “Berapa harga barang sialan ini?”

4307e1bd0d73.en: Getting paid good money to do this ain’t bad. Kibe, dropping the used nari chain in the ground like a filthy smoker would throw out a cigarette butt, grabbed another chain, and repeated the process. His satisfaction started to wane, as he mechanically kept feeding one chain of nari after the other into Gabiro’s palm, leaving behind an almost empty box. “Eleven.” Kibe confirmed the eleventh ball of double helices had just come into existence by itself in the third ring, after a lot more than eleven nari chains were fed into it.
4307e1bd0d73.t: Dibayar mahal untuk melakukan ini lumayan juga. Kibe, menjatuhkan rantai nari bekas ke lantai seperti perokok jorok membuang puntung rokok, mengambil rantai lain, dan mengulangi prosesnya. Kepuasannya mulai memudar, saat ia secara mekanis terus mengumpankan rantai nari satu demi satu ke telapak tangan Gabiro, meninggalkan kotak yang hampir kosong. “Sebelas.” Kibe memastikan bola heliks ganda kesebelas baru saja muncul dengan sendirinya di cincin ketiga, setelah jauh lebih dari sebelas rantai nari diumpankan ke dalamnya.

44340d49af40.en: Oops. A strained smile appeared on Kibe’s face, slowly rubbing his suddenly sore neck. “Two aquamarines and three amethysts.” His voice sounded sure on the surface, but hollow inside, just like a new facade of a crumbling building.
44340d49af40.t: Waduh. Senyum tegang muncul di wajah Kibe, perlahan menggosok lehernya yang tiba-tiba pegal. “Dua aquamarine dan tiga amethyst.” Suaranya terdengar yakin di permukaan, tetapi kosong di dalam, persis seperti fasad baru dari bangunan yang sedang runtuh.

444c5a79bed4.en: “Of course not! I didn’t tell them we were experimenting with a new fake skin.” Kibe’s hand moved by itself towards his nose to scratch a sudden itch.
444c5a79bed4.t: “Tentu saja tidak! Aku tidak bilang kita sedang bereksperimen dengan fake skin baru.” Tangan Kibe bergerak sendiri ke arah hidungnya untuk menggaruk rasa gatal yang tiba-tiba.

44d80a49fac8.en: “DAMMIT, KIBE—” Before Gabiro could finish his sentence, the flame reached his elbow, gaining momentum as it dissolved everything on its path. Letting go of his arm, he grabbed the knife with his only hand, and stabbed his shoulder. He grunted from the pain—the same white ooze poured from the stab wounds, rather than blood. “KIBE! FUCK! Do something! Cut my head off!” Gabiro moved his old frail hand towards Kibe, and tried to take a step, but didn’t move very far. “NOW!”
44d80a49fac8.t: “SIALAN, KIBE—” Sebelum Gabiro bisa menyelesaikan kalimatnya, api itu mencapai sikunya, semakin kencang saat melarutkan segala sesuatu di jalurnya. Melepaskan lengannya, ia meraih pisau dengan satu-satunya tangan yang tersisa, dan menusuk bahunya. Ia mengerang kesakitan—lendir putih yang sama mengalir dari luka tusukan itu, bukan darah. “KIBE! BANGSAT! Lakukan sesuatu! Penggal kepalaku!” Gabiro menggerakkan tangannya yang tua dan rapuh ke arah Kibe, dan mencoba melangkah, tetapi tidak bergerak jauh. “SEKARANG!”

496cc4daa75f.en: “Ahhhh—” Frozen in space, Kibe only let out a murmur, seeing Gabiro’s forearm becoming oozy and pooling in the ground.
496cc4daa75f.t: “Ahhhh—” Membeku di tempat, Kibe hanya bergumam, melihat lengan bawah Gabiro menjadi lendir dan menggenang di lantai.

506aa7c947fd.en: Gabiro clenched his left hand, but left his middle and ring fingers out flat—kinda as if he was flipping the bird. When he did so, he caused a bluish fire to emerge from his left hand, and arm. It danced back and forth, like the flame of a gas stove if you move the gas dial back and forth. Even though this ethereal-like flame seemed to be in direct contact with his skin, it did appear to cause any kind of burns. As if he was practicing a ritual handed down through the generations, he then proceeded to touch the two left fingers into the right palm and moved the clenched right fingers to envelop the left fingers, looking just like a Venus flytrap catching flies. With absolute, confident trapping motions of the right hand, appearing as if it was eating the left fingers, a rhythmic wave of bluish excited flames arose high on the left arm and hand, before rushing towards Gabiro’s sagging, bleeding palm of his right hand. As it clashed, the blue flames disappeared inside the palm, all while a white ball with a trailing tail composed of double helix strands, like a yarn ball made of DNA, emerged into existence and spun around on the smallest ring around Gabiro’s right arm, as if trying to free itself.
506aa7c947fd.t: Gabiro mengepalkan tangan kirinya, tetapi membiarkan jari tengah dan jari manisnya terentang datar—agak seolah sedang mengacungkan jari tengah. Saat ia melakukannya, ia membuat api kebiruan muncul dari tangan kiri dan lengannya. Api itu menari maju mundur, seperti nyala kompor gas kalau kamu memutar tombol gasnya maju mundur. Walaupun api yang tampak eteris ini tampaknya bersentuhan langsung dengan kulitnya, api itu tidak tampak menimbulkan luka bakar apa pun. Seolah sedang mempraktikkan ritual yang diwariskan turun-temurun, ia lalu menyentuhkan dua jari kiri ke telapak tangan kanan dan menggerakkan jari-jari kanan yang terkepal untuk menyelimuti jari-jari kiri, tampak persis seperti tanaman Venus flytrap yang menangkap lalat. Dengan gerakan menjebak tangan kanan yang mutlak dan percaya diri, tampak seolah tangan itu sedang memakan jari-jari kiri, gelombang api kebiruan yang bergairah dan berirama naik tinggi di lengan dan tangan kiri, sebelum bergegas menuju telapak tangan kanan Gabiro yang kendur dan berdarah. Saat beradu, api biru itu menghilang ke dalam telapak tangan, sementara bola putih dengan ekor yang terdiri dari untaian heliks ganda, seperti gulungan benang yang terbuat dari DNA, muncul dan berputar di cincin terkecil di sekitar lengan kanan Gabiro, seolah berusaha membebaskan dirinya.

510e3888d7e6.en: If you’re going to be this much of a jerk, then you should have just gone to pick it up yourself. Kibe, still finding things to look at other than Gabiro, tried to mince his words as his wide shoulders shrugged. “Huh—well, first. You didn’t give me enough time or—”
510e3888d7e6.t: Kalau kau mau jadi sebrengsek ini, seharusnya kau ambil saja sendiri. Kibe, masih mencari hal-hal lain untuk dipandang selain Gabiro, mencoba memilih kata-katanya dengan hati-hati sambil bahunya yang lebar terangkat. “Hah—yah, pertama. Kau tidak memberiku cukup waktu atau—”

56f18f2f344d.en: Refusing to acknowledge Kibe, Gabiro clenched the fingers of his right hand, leaving the bleeding palm exposed. A trail of harmless white fire emerged from his middle and ring fingers, and rushed up his arm, in a vein-like pattern, towards his back. Afterwards, five circles of white fire popped into existence around his right arm—surging from the white fire in his arms. Gabiro let out a long-frustrated groan, and began chanting, almost as if he had memorized it like the lyrics of a catchy, but cringy song. “A man out of this world! He needs to stand big and tall, but not a giant like Darfaries. He must be assertive, yet charismatic! A true listener!”
56f18f2f344d.t: Menolak menghiraukan Kibe, Gabiro mengepalkan jari-jari tangan kanannya, membiarkan telapak tangannya yang berdarah terbuka. Jejak api putih yang tidak berbahaya muncul dari jari tengah dan jari manisnya, dan menjalar naik di lengannya, dalam pola seperti urat, menuju punggungnya. Setelah itu, lima lingkaran api putih muncul di sekitar lengan kanannya—menyembur dari api putih di lengannya. Gabiro mengerang panjang dengan frustrasi, dan mulai merapal, hampir seolah ia sudah menghafalnya seperti lirik lagu yang catchy tapi norak. “Seorang pria dari luar dunia ini! Ia harus berdiri besar dan tinggi, tetapi bukan raksasa seperti Darfaries. Ia harus tegas, namun karismatik! Seorang pendengar sejati!”

5eda7d50703d.en: The jab attempts stopped. Gabiro now looked at the dead Bagarisa with a meticulous scientific glint in his eyes. “Was it that hard to hunt it down?”
5eda7d50703d.t: Upaya tusukan itu berhenti. Gabiro kini memandang Bagarisa mati itu dengan kilau ilmiah yang teliti di matanya. “Apa memang sesulit itu memburunya?”

5f167b12d062.en: Like a flashbang, a suddenly blinding flash lit up the entire room, taking over his senses, including his capability of thought.
5f167b12d062.t: Seperti granat kejut, kilatan yang tiba-tiba menyilaukan menerangi seluruh ruangan, mengambil alih indranya, termasuk kemampuannya untuk berpikir.

64ba998ad23e.en: “No logogram?” Kibe could not help himself, taking a peek into the bleeding carvings in Gabiro’s rubbery skin.
64ba998ad23e.t: “Tanpa logogram?” Kibe tidak bisa menahan diri, mengintip ukiran berdarah di kulit Gabiro yang seperti karet.

739c37f98f26.en: Gabiro sharply asked, “What did you tell them?”
739c37f98f26.t: Gabiro bertanya dengan tajam, “Apa yang kau katakan pada mereka?”

7de80640e90d.en: That’s new. Kibe, speechless, and incapable of blinking, watched every detail of the white fire as it slowly swallowed the entire bagarisa corpse, like a snake eating a deer. The flaming white ooze began to spread on the table, slowly inching to its edges like thick molasses. “What interface is that?”
7de80640e90d.t: Itu baru. Kibe, tanpa kata, dan tak mampu berkedip, menonton setiap detail api putih itu saat perlahan menelan seluruh bangkai bagarisa, seperti ular yang memakan rusa. Lendir putih yang menyala itu mulai menyebar di meja, perlahan merayap ke tepi-tepinya seperti molase kental. “Antarmuka apa itu?”

857ebff760cd.en: “AWW! FUCK!” Gabiro clenched his teeth. Looking at the hole left behind by the worm, he saw the same white flame oozing out. “AW SHIT! QUICK! Grab the knife!” Gabiro held his right arm, applying as much pressure as he could, trying to restrict the blood flow, while a white curtain of flame constantly marched steadily towards his forearm, liquefying his own flesh and making it drip onto the ground.
857ebff760cd.t: “AWW! BANGSAT!” Gabiro menggertakkan giginya. Memandang lubang yang ditinggalkan cacing itu, ia melihat api putih yang sama merembes keluar. “AW SIAL! CEPAT! Ambil pisaunya!” Gabiro memegang lengan kanannya, menekan sekuat mungkin, berusaha membatasi aliran darah, sementara tirai api putih terus bergerak mantap menuju lengan bawahnya, mencairkan dagingnya sendiri dan membuatnya menetes ke lantai.

8b4760d94a70.en: I hope he buys it. Kibe, appearing to use his muscle reflexes, grabbed the end of the trembling walking stick, and calmly held back the attempted stabs. Breaking eye contact, he slightly shrugged, “Expensive, yes, but I had no choice. The two aquamarine adventurers did not want to negotiate! They said they brought it back from south of Hifuna to mount as a trophy.”
8b4760d94a70.t: Semoga dia percaya. Kibe, tampaknya memakai refleks ototnya, meraih ujung tongkat jalan yang gemetar itu, dan dengan tenang menahan upaya tusukan itu. Memutus kontak mata, ia sedikit mengangkat bahu, “Mahal, iya, tapi aku tidak punya pilihan. Dua petualang aquamarine itu tidak mau menawar! Mereka bilang mereka membawanya kembali dari selatan Hifuna untuk dipajang sebagai trofi.”

9336fdee4ca4.en: Gabiro sized up the corpse, paying close attention to its large, wide back, and impressive dark red mane. Gabiro’s chin-stroking paused as his eyes shifted back to Kibe. “You didn’t tell them what this was for, right?”
9336fdee4ca4.t: Gabiro menaksir bangkai itu, memperhatikan baik-baik punggungnya yang besar dan lebar, serta surai merah tuanya yang mengesankan. Usapan dagu Gabiro terhenti saat matanya beralih kembali ke Kibe. “Kau tidak memberi tahu mereka ini untuk apa, kan?”

93c1323c49e8.en: Like waking up from a dream, Kibe took a deep breath, opening his eyes, but now he saw himself in a private hot spring accompanied by large friendly humanoids that he could not fully identify. The comforting warmth, the natural forest aroma in the air, plus the company of people he liked meant the world to him. He relaxed his face, dipping further into the hot water with a vacant mind.
93c1323c49e8.t: Seperti bangun dari mimpi, Kibe menarik napas dalam-dalam, membuka matanya, tetapi kini ia melihat dirinya di pemandian air panas pribadi ditemani humanoid-humanoid besar yang ramah yang tidak bisa ia kenali sepenuhnya. Kehangatan yang menenangkan, aroma hutan alami di udara, ditambah kebersamaan dengan orang-orang yang ia sukai, sangat berarti baginya. Ia mengendurkan wajahnya, berendam lebih dalam ke air panas dengan pikiran kosong.

960b63c4efbd.en: Gabiro, disrobed down to his blue boxers with white fish symbols, was browsing the drawers. Without even looking at Kibe, he continued to search for something. “We’re doing something different today.” With his left hand, he grabbed a simple-looking short knife that contained beautiful carving of a fish jumping, and stood back in front of the corpse. Both hands were in front of him, close to chest level. His left hand held the knife pointed towards the right palm, which was laid with its fingers laid out flat, as if trying to high-five the knife.
960b63c4efbd.t: Gabiro, yang sudah melepas pakaiannya sampai tinggal boxer biru bersimbol ikan putih, sedang memeriksa laci-laci. Bahkan tanpa memandang Kibe, ia terus mencari sesuatu. “Kita melakukan sesuatu yang berbeda hari ini.” Dengan tangan kirinya, ia mengambil sebuah pisau pendek yang tampak sederhana dengan ukiran indah ikan yang melompat, dan berdiri kembali di depan bangkai itu. Kedua tangannya di depannya, dekat setinggi dada. Tangan kirinya memegang pisau yang diarahkan ke telapak tangan kanan, yang terbuka dengan jari-jari terentang datar, seolah mencoba bertos dengan pisau itu.

9b8f9f347cd3.en: Gabiro clenched his hand, making the blue hue inside the nari stone rush towards the palm, leaving behind an empty, crystalline, diamond-like stone.
9b8f9f347cd3.t: Gabiro mengepalkan tangannya, membuat rona biru di dalam batu nari itu bergegas menuju telapak tangannya, meninggalkan batu yang kosong, berkristal, mirip berlian.

a2d59a1cad4a.en: “Sorry. What?” Kibe was still remembering the intricacies of how he got to know Lukino, so he was half-heartedly paying attention.
a2d59a1cad4a.t: “Maaf. Apa?” Kibe masih mengingat-ingat seluk-beluk bagaimana ia mengenal Lukino, jadi ia memperhatikan setengah hati.

ab8d179cccee.en: Gabiro entrapped his left fingers again, but this time things behaved differently. The blue flames of his left forearm rushed thought the hand, and into the palm, then flamed out, while no new white ball of DNA appeared in the rings once he stopped entrapping.
ab8d179cccee.t: Gabiro menjebak jari-jari kirinya lagi, tetapi kali ini segalanya berperilaku berbeda. Api biru di lengan bawah kirinya bergegas melewati tangan, dan masuk ke telapak tangan, lalu padam, sementara tidak ada bola DNA putih baru yang muncul di cincin-cincin itu begitu ia berhenti menjebak.

b068bf39f193.en: Gabiro took a deep breath, closing his eyes. “Because I felt like it. Now shut the fuck up, and get ready to feed nari until we reach eleven.” Gabiro proceeded to slice open his palm, making two similarly sized squares, leaving the first square empty and making a plus sign inside the other.
b068bf39f193.t: Gabiro menarik napas dalam-dalam, memejamkan matanya. “Karena aku sedang ingin saja. Sekarang diam, bangsat, dan bersiaplah mengumpankan nari sampai kita mencapai sebelas.” Gabiro lalu menyayat telapak tangannya, membuat dua kotak berukuran serupa, membiarkan kotak pertama kosong dan membuat tanda tambah di dalam kotak lainnya.

b1495325acf5.en: “—that’s why I didn’t tell you the truth, you dumbass.” These words slipped out under Gabiro’s breath, barely making it to Kibe.
b1495325acf5.t: “—itulah sebabnya aku tidak memberitahumu yang sebenarnya, dasar goblok.” Kata-kata itu lolos dalam bisikan Gabiro, nyaris tidak sampai ke Kibe.

b4fb6ddb0da6.en: “And you didn’t go into the details?” Gabiro raised one of his white, hairy eyebrows.
b4fb6ddb0da6.t: “Dan kau tidak menjelaskan detailnya?” Gabiro mengangkat salah satu alisnya yang putih dan lebat.

b72fb00627cc.en: “Whatever. They are going to spend all the balls on the pub anyway—let’s get this shit over with.” Gabiro placed his walking stick on the table, and proceeded to disrobe by untangling the blue ribbon on his stomach, and opening his bathrobe-like clothing like he was a diva—full of prideful elegance.
b72fb00627cc.t: “Terserahlah. Toh mereka akan menghabiskan semua bolanya di kedai minum—ayo kita selesaikan urusan sialan ini.” Gabiro meletakkan tongkat jalannya di meja, lalu melepas pakaiannya dengan membuka ikatan pita biru di perutnya, dan membuka pakaiannya yang mirip jubah mandi seolah ia seorang diva—penuh keanggunan yang angkuh.

b919e59aebba.en: Seeing the white fire consuming the worm, liquefying it into the ooze, Kibe felt a primordial fear strike at his chest. He stepped back, just in case whatever this ooze thing was started to crawl towards him as it began to drip onto the floor.
b919e59aebba.t: Melihat api putih melahap cacing itu, mencairkannya menjadi lendir, Kibe merasakan rasa takut purba menghantam dadanya. Ia mundur, berjaga-jaga kalau-kalau benda lendir apa pun ini mulai merayap ke arahnya saat mulai menetes ke lantai.

bb0badde86b1.en: Kibe remembered meeting with the two adventurers, then happening to go drinking with one of them, a taller muscled human by the name of Lukino. His mind was slightly sparse on the details, possibly due to over indulging in talking to Lukino amidst pounding a few beers in a local bar. At the same time, he for sure remembered renting the most expensive room to get to know that adventurer through means other than talking. “Noooo—?” Kibe’s voice ended with somewhere between an exclamation and a question, holding back what appeared to be another grin forming.
bb0badde86b1.t: Kibe teringat pertemuannya dengan dua petualang itu, lalu kebetulan pergi minum dengan salah satunya, seorang manusia yang lebih tinggi dan berotot bernama Lukino. Ingatannya agak kabur soal detailnya, mungkin karena terlalu asyik mengobrol dengan Lukino sambil menenggak beberapa bir di bar setempat. Pada saat yang sama, ia jelas ingat menyewa kamar paling mahal untuk mengenal petualang itu dengan cara lain selain mengobrol. “Tiiidak—?” Suara Kibe berakhir di antara seruan dan pertanyaan, menahan apa yang tampaknya seringai lain yang mulai terbentuk.

ca893d308e2b.en: Five white balls of DNA appeared on the soul rings: two on the smallest one, closest to Gabiro’s wrist, and three on the following ring.
ca893d308e2b.t: Lima bola DNA putih muncul di cincin-cincin jiwa: dua di cincin terkecil, yang paling dekat dengan pergelangan tangan Gabiro, dan tiga di cincin berikutnya.

dc1f8706622e.en: “I didn’t tell them anything!” Kibe’s voice trailed as his eyes began looking away again. Well, I guess I did tell them a bit. His voice trailed off, “Other than say it was for an experiment—”
dc1f8706622e.t: “Aku tidak mengatakan apa-apa pada mereka!” Suara Kibe memelan sementara matanya mulai memandang ke arah lain lagi. Yah, kurasa aku memang memberi tahu mereka sedikit. Suaranya memelan, “Selain bilang ini untuk sebuah eksperimen—”

dd98919c5300.en: A loud shush came from Gabiro. His eyes were forcibly shut, and his brows furrowed firmly, continuously speaking out loud, “His body needs to be muscular, yet he must be a comfortable body pillow—he needs to be fertile, and his schlong needs to be hard as rock, and veiny as a weightlifter, but not as big as a Darfaries’s. His balls must be filled with fertility, and warm to the touch. His eyes must be sparkly green, his hair must be golden blonde, and he must not have a beard, or body hair.”
dd98919c5300.t: Desisan keras untuk diam keluar dari Gabiro. Matanya terpejam paksa, dan alisnya berkerut kuat, terus berbicara keras-keras, “Tubuhnya harus berotot, namun ia harus menjadi bantal guling yang nyaman—ia harus subur, dan batangnya harus sekeras batu, dan berurat seperti pengangkat beban, tetapi tidak sebesar milik Darfaries. Biji pelernya harus penuh kesuburan, dan hangat saat disentuh. Matanya harus hijau berkilau, rambutnya harus pirang keemasan, dan ia tidak boleh berjanggut, atau berbulu badan.”

e4a11540c5bf.en: Kibe watched the knife, ready to cut Gabiro’s old frail skin. “Okay—that’s why we are going old-school?”
e4a11540c5bf.t: Kibe memperhatikan pisau itu, siap memotong kulit Gabiro yang tua dan rapuh. “Oke—jadi itu sebabnya kita pakai cara kuno?”

e70d48511873.en: Meanwhile, with deep breaths and beads of sweat running down his forehead, Gabiro placed his right hand in the bloating corpse. His face clenched in revulsion and disgust as the corpse juices dirtied his saggy hand. As Gabiro slowly unclenched his fingers, it ripped apart the rotting skin, exposing the worms from underneath having a feast on the dead flesh. The rings around his arms collapsed into one another, growing brighter as they rushed towards the hand, traveling through the wrist, and exploding outward from the palm with a white flame that covered the butt of the bagarisa corpse, appearing to liquify the flesh from within.
e70d48511873.t: Sementara itu, dengan napas dalam dan butiran keringat mengalir di dahinya, Gabiro meletakkan tangan kanannya di bangkai yang membengkak itu. Wajahnya mengerut jijik dan muak saat cairan bangkai mengotori tangannya yang kendur. Saat Gabiro perlahan membuka genggaman jari-jarinya, kulit yang membusuk itu robek, memperlihatkan cacing-cacing di bawahnya yang sedang berpesta daging mati. Cincin-cincin di sekitar lengannya runtuh ke dalam satu sama lain, semakin terang saat bergegas menuju tangan, melewati pergelangan tangan, dan meledak keluar dari telapak tangan dengan api putih yang menyelimuti bokong bangkai bagarisa itu, tampak mencairkan daging dari dalam.

e72c49b3713f.en: He’s crankier than usual. A ponderous apprentice by the name of Kibe moved his eyes around the unusually large specimen of bagarisa, while avoiding glancing back at the source of the accusing voice. “You’re the one who asked me to bring the most powerful thing around.”
e72c49b3713f.t: Dia lebih rewel dari biasanya. Seorang murid yang termenung bernama Kibe menggerakkan matanya ke sekeliling spesimen bagarisa yang luar biasa besar itu, sambil menghindari menoleh ke sumber suara yang menuduh itu. “Kau sendiri yang menyuruhku membawa makhluk paling kuat di sekitar sini.”

ec6f4a7f2a69.en: “—huh—second, you only gave me three aquamarines.” Kibe paused, waiting for the counterargument which surely was going to come. And here we go again—
ec6f4a7f2a69.t: “—hah—kedua, kau cuma memberiku tiga aquamarine.” Kibe terdiam, menunggu bantahan yang pasti akan datang. Dan mulai lagi—

f16519b86766.en: Kibe felt himself levitating, as if he was going down on an intense roller coaster, only to have a sudden feeling of being crushed as if a drunk truck driver rear ended him.
f16519b86766.t: Kibe merasa dirinya melayang, seolah sedang meluncur turun di roller coaster yang dahsyat, hanya untuk tiba-tiba merasa diremukkan seolah ditabrak dari belakang oleh sopir truk yang mabuk.

f1ac90e41920.en: Prologue subchapter 1: a silver-haired man and an old scientist with a blue head stripe argue over a dead tusked boar-like animal on a table.
f1ac90e41920.t: Prolog subbab 1: seorang pria berambut perak dan seorang ilmuwan tua dengan garis biru di kepalanya berdebat di atas hewan mirip babi hutan bertaring yang mati di atas meja.

f7971145aefb.en: “WHAT?” Gabiro raised his walking stick, covered in cyan fish scales, and prepared to jam it on Kibe’s guts. His trembling hands raised the massive weight of the stick—it was just a normal walking stick, but it was simply too much for Gabiro’s bulimic forearms.
f7971145aefb.t: “APA?” Gabiro mengangkat tongkat jalannya, yang dilapisi sisik ikan berwarna sian, dan bersiap menusukkannya ke perut Kibe. Tangannya yang gemetar mengangkat beban tongkat yang begitu berat—padahal itu hanya tongkat jalan biasa, tetapi terlalu berat bagi lengan bawah Gabiro yang kurus kering.
